title: Design System: REED Kalisz — Public Website

contact-orange-bright.displayName: Contact Orange Bright (on navy and ink)

hero.purpose: The homepage hero line alone, two-toned (emphasis in bright orange on navy).

headline.purpose: Page titles and every homepage section head (Title blocks, Katalog, Siedziba, closing ask).

title.purpose: Band heads (Siedziba, SEO), the catalogue map, CMS prose h2.

subtitle.purpose: Catalogue cell names, SEO block heads, footer column heads.

body.purpose: Default; CMS prose at 1.7 in ink-500, 68ch.

body-small.purpose: Controls (at 700), nav, band copy, city lists.

price.purpose: Product card price, tabular, stepping down in narrow cards.

label.purpose: Mono tracked uppercase for functional captions and badges; never a kicker.

shadows.name: rule
shadows.purpose: The system's separator in place of shadows: band edges, the rail's edge, the bar's foot, toolbars.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Genuine overlays only: product-page toast, phone floating Zapytaj, a 2x-zoomed gallery thumbnail (0.18).

shadows.name: edge-ring
shadows.purpose: Hover thickening of a card or pager edge without shifting content; not a shadow.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Global :focus-visible; --focus is red, orange inside the question form. Product cards draw a 3px red inset outline.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Movement: arrows, chevrons, dots growing, photo fades.

motion.name: ease-hover
motion.purpose: Hover colours (grounds, borders, rings, link colours): a soft start, so a pointer there for a frame (crossing an edge, a shaking hand) shows nothing. A .btn's label colour swaps at once at 30% of its 200ms instead of fading, never passing through its ground's shade.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: Buttons, arrow slides (0.1875rem), chevron flips, photo fades (x1.5).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global clamp; hover transforms are also cancelled per component.

layout.name: bleed
layout.purpose: How far ruled cells and banners reach past the column, text staying in it.

layout.name: pill-hang
layout.purpose: How far a pill starting a text column hangs past it (.hang).

layout.name: rail
layout.purpose: Sticky desktop rail from 61.25rem; the footer's column starts after it.

narrative.overview:
The public site is set like a poster from a print shop, not assembled from a catalog template: one paper sheet edge to edge, flat navy fields for structure (hero, Siedziba, SEO, the rail's contact head), and 2px ink rules wherever a softer system would reach for a shadow. Bricolage Grotesque does the shouting, the hero two-toned with its second clause in bright orange.

Colour is assigned by job: REED red is action, state, focus, the sale badge and the logo tile; navy is structure; orange is contact (every /kontakt and phone control and the question form, its bright shade on navy). Blocks are square and ruled; controls are squircled pills.

The arrangement inside is the familiar catalogue: a sticky rail that is the whole navigation, a product grid, a product page ending in an inquiry. The admin panel is a separate system (design-admin.json).
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground edge to edge; warm ink ramp
Flat navy fields; 2px ink rules; no resting shadows
Red = action/state, navy = structure, orange = contact
Bricolage Grotesque for all text; platform mono for codes, labels, badges
Square blocks, pill controls, one card radius for the inquiry panel
Sticky 16.5rem rail on desktop; Zadzwoń + Menu bar on a phone
Inquiry is the terminal action; no cart

rules.name: The Three Jobs Rule
rules.body: Red is action and state, navy is structure, orange is contact. A colour never borrows another's job.

rules.name: The Orange Means Contact Rule
rules.body: If a control writes to REED, calls REED or goes to /kontakt it is orange, and nothing else is. The sale badge is red.

rules.name: The Bright-On-Dark Rule
rules.body: On navy or ink, contact uses the bright orange with ink text on its fills; the dark orange is for paper.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Bricolage carries every text role; mono is for codes, functional captions and badges.

rules.name: The Hero Owns Its Size Rule
rules.body: The hero size appears once; section heads stop at headline.

rules.name: The Hang Rule
rules.body: A pill starting a text column hangs past it by --pill-hang (0.3rem) so its round end sits on the column edge; stacked full-width pills hang both sides.

rules.name: The Column Edge Rule
rules.body: Text aligns to the column at every width, inside full-bleed bands, banners and the footer beside the rail.

rules.name: The Rule Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: A 2px ink rule separates, a navy field groups; shadows only for genuine overlays.

dos: Do make every contact control orange (bright on navy and ink, deep for outlined text on paper).
Do keep red for action, current state, focus, the sale badge and the logo tile.
Do use navy for structural bands only.
Do separate with a 2px ink rule, never doubled where bands meet.
Do keep text on the column edge at every width.
Do set section heads at headline, leaving hero to the hero.
Do keep blocks square and controls squircled pills.
Don't fold the SEO copy or the catalogue map behind a disclosure: the page jumps when one opens and visitors who never click miss it.
Do end the homepage on the closing ask and product pages on the inquiry.
donts: Don't use orange for promotions or sale prices.
Don't put a resting shadow on a card, band or panel.
Don't add a third shape or round the product cards.
Don't add a third type family or a second hero-size element.
Don't write kickers or eyebrows above headings.
Don't design cart or checkout affordances.
Don't imply proof that doesn't exist (testimonials, client logos, turnaround promises, invented counts).
Don't use glyph or emoji icons in the chrome.
Don't hardcode values a token covers or use the legacy --main/--light aliases in new work.
Don't replace, recolour or retype the REED logo.
